headline: Myths vs. Facts About Apartment Fire Cleanup
articleBody: It's easy to get caught up in misinformation when you're trying to recover from an apartment fire, so let's clear up some common myths. Myth: You can just paint over smoke damage. Fact: Nope! Smoke and soot residues will bleed through paint and the odor will linger. Professional cleanup involves specific methods to remove these contaminants, not just cover them up. Myth: A small fire means small damage, so I can clean it myself. Fact: Even a small fire creates pervasive smoke and soot, which can cause significant corrosion and health risks if not properly remediated. Professionals like First To Respond Restoration have the tools to handle these invisible threats. Myth: My landlord will handle everything, I don't need to do anything. Fact: While your landlord is responsible for the building, your personal belongings and living situation often fall under your renter's insurance. It's crucial to contact your insurance agent immediately. Myth: All odors will eventually disappear on their own. Fact: Smoke odors can be incredibly stubborn and become embedded in materials. Professional odor removal is necessary for true elimination, not just masking. When facing an apartment fire, trust the experts to guide you through the facts.
